run_f_gold: run f_gold to count distinct occurrences of subsequence T in string S using dynamic programming
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter set of string pairs
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to reduce space complexity from O(m*n) to O(n) for subsequence counting
review_f_gold: review f_gold dynamic programming approach for counting distinct subsequence occurrences in a string
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which uses a 2D DP matrix to count distinct subsequence matches of T in S
